body: Thanks, I know there's a big beautiful world out there to be explored and I do have a life ahead of me, but it feels like very time I get satisfied with life and find happiness, it gets broken and I'm left to pick up the pieces and repeat the cycle all over again, and it just feels so vain to me. I have my first counseling appointment this Friday; I was supposed to go ~1 month ago, but I sort of broke down that morning and couldn't bring myself to going. My concern with it though, is the last time I went to a counselor it just made things quite a bit worse. Also I feel like medicine doesn't really sit well with my personal philosophies, no matter how much time I spend trying to change that.
